label: sec:archimedean-hartree-crystal-alpha-em-categorical-preamble
html: Across successive fermion generations and momentum scales, the effective electromagnetic coupling shifts according to the Markov trace ratio of the corresponding braid levels. This section derives the categorical trace-ratio formula for the running of \alpha_{\mathrm{EM}}, proves the multiplicative chain rule for generation shifts, defines the Schwinger computational time measure and q-chromaticity confinement criterion, and formulates the Schrödinger colour-falsifiability tables.
